title: Specified coefficient square and open-unit normalization
statement: For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion] and finite coefficient map $\varphi:A\to B$, use the section-normalized realization comparisons [def-sf-compact-support-restriction-data] and intrinsic open restriction and extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Define sfOpenRestrictionCoefficientSquare by transporting the identity fixed-scalar restriction square through the realization comparisons. Define sfOpenFixedRestrictionId to be the sectionwise identity for the identity coefficient map; transport it through realization and the counit to obtain sfOpenCoefficientRestrictionId. Define SfOpenRestrictionNormalized to be the displayed open-adjunction unit equation [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction] with sfOpenRestrictionCoefficientSquare. These are the four existing definitions, with unchanged names and bodies; their uniqueness and coherence laws remain in the original coherence module.
